requirements.quote: verify #intent the intent is one sentence before generate structure findings
requirements.reason: Intent verified before structure, details, tests.

requirements.quote: ask user for the author's clarification of the PR intent as clarification
requirements.reason: Failed verification asks for clarification then retries before continuing.

requirements.quote: read PR description and changed code from target as change
requirements.reason: Reads description; intent must state the problem being solved.

requirements.quote: **structure questions**: ask whether this follows existing codebase patterns and whether new abstractions are justified.
check code quality, security and performance. Ask about N+1 queries
requirements.reason: Covers quality, security, performance, N+1, secrets, injection, and verifies all checked.

requirements.quote: Baseline is OWASP Top 10.
ask whether edge cases are covered and whether tests assert behavior, not implementation.
verify #tests tests were reviewed as thoroughly as code from tests
Critical issues are noted immediately, not held to the end.
acknowledge the author's stated reasoning before suggesting any alternative.
requirements.reason: Conditional on author comments, as in source.

requirements.quote: drop style nitpicks and never block on style or personal preferences when a linter or formatter is configured.
never block on personal preferences
never be condescending or rude
never demand perfection
nothing reviewed without understanding the why from report
requirements.reason: Verified at report stage, plus intent verification of the problem.

requirements.quote: be specific and actionable
include code examples in suggestions
praise good patterns specifically
prioritize critical to minor
Sections in order: Summary (one-sentence intent recap plus overall assessment), Critical issues
Verdict (Approve / Request Changes / Comment)
Read-only: this skill reads, searches and reports; it never edits the code under review.
